D014-D008_h025.question:
For over three years, maybe even longer, it feels like this gray cloud has just been hanging over me. Most days, I just feel this deep sadness, like a heavy cloak I can't shake off. It makes it really hard to focus on my art, or anything, really. I’ll try to read for a project, or even just watch a movie, and my mind just drifts, completely unable to concentrate. I used to be so passionate, but now I doubt everything I do. I look at my canvases and just think, "What's the point? I can't even get this right."

But then, sometimes, it's like a switch flips. For a few days, I'll have this incredible burst of energy. I’ll stay up all night painting, sketching concepts, feeling absolutely brilliant and unstoppable. My thoughts race, ideas come so fast I can barely keep up. I feel like I could conquer the world, like all my doubts vanish. I even feel this amazing confidence, like my art is truly groundbreaking. But then it fizzles out, and I'm back to the dull ache, the feeling of incompetence. It’s exhausting, this back and forth.
